summary.text: Adjusting the scheduled Oct 23 pizza time from 1pm to noon after Maya’s request and confirming agreement.
Resolving a date ambiguity between this Friday and October 23 while keeping the time change consistent.
Drafting a dialogue with speaker labels and a writer note while enforcing pronoun and acceptance constraints.

content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: ugh morning, my alarm went off like three times
Me: same, i snoozed twice and now i'm rushing
Maya: lol are you already at work or still home
Me: still home, leaving in like 10, coffee first
Maya: priorities, i just made oat latte again
Me: ooh how is the dairy-free test going day 3
Maya: actually good, stomach way less gross this morning
Me: that's promising, no cheese regrets?
Maya: so many regrets but my gut says thanks
Me: lol fair trade i guess
Maya: did you water your sad plants again or are they still droopy
Me: i watered them sunday so they're okay for now
Maya: proud, mine are fine, basil still living on the windowsill
Me: miracle basil refuses to die, love that
Maya: right? it's getting so much sun there
Me: my kitchen is still a cave, thinking of moving mine too
Maya: do it, windowsill changed everything
Maya: oh btw did you survive monday emails
Me: barely, inbox was a nightmare yesterday
Maya: same, i have a standup at 9 so i'm just scrolling til then
Me: good luck, mine start at like 9:30 ugh
Maya: hey so random planning thing
Maya: our Rosa's thing next friday, the 23rd
Me: yeah i'm still counting down to it
Maya: me too, but can we move it earlier?
Maya: like noon instead of 1 pm?
Me: oh yeah noon works for me
Maya: really? thank you, i have something at 2 that day now
Me: oh work thing?
Maya: yeah dumb back to back got added, 1 is gonna be too tight
Me: totally get it, noon is actually better for slipping out anyway
Maya: perfect, less rush for me too
Me: are you still wfh that day so you can just walk over?
Maya: yeah, i'll walk over a little before
Me: i'll slip out from office, grab us a table
Maya: patio if it's not freezing? or inside is fine
Me: i'll check and do my chair safety test lol
Maya: your official duty, very important
Me: seriously, can't risk wobbly chairs
Maya: did your maybe-mug survive glazing tonight?
Me: oh it's tonight, i'm nervous lol it's so lopsided
Maya: functional art, the kiln will be kind
Me: hopefully, tuesday guy says hi btw
Maya: lol tell him my sister still says someday
Me: classic, she locked in her birthday thing right
Maya: yeah next saturday at 4 at Rosa's with her friends
Me: cute, hope patio weather holds for them
Maya: me too, i told her half order knots to start
Me: you're training her well
Maya: trying, tho i'll be doing veggie no-cheese while she gets real pizza, jealous
Me: i'll do the same with you so you don't feel weird
Maya: you don't have to but thank you, dairy-free solidarity
Me: it's fine, marinara + veggie still hits the pizza vibe
Maya: and i'll just smell the knots from other tables lol
Me: tragic, stupid timing for the test
Maya: i know, but gotta be strict for a few weeks, no milk cheese butter
Me: makes sense, then we go back to full knots after
Maya: exactly, countdown to real cheese again
Maya: what are you having for lunch today btw
Me: probably sad desk salad again, very boring
Maya: lol classic, i'm doing soup again, tomato can supremacy
Me: add grilled cheese? oh wait you can't
Maya: rude but true, just soup and crackers for me
Me: sorryyy, oat latte and soup era
Maya: exactly, glamorous
Maya: okay i gotta hop on this call, talk later?
Me: yeah good luck, hope it's not one that could've been a text
Maya: it definitely could've been, bye lol
Me: bye, see you at noon on the 23rd!",
  "writer_note": "Kept it as a busy Tuesday-morning check-in with work, plants, and dairy-free test chatter to bury the schedule change naturally, while making the Oct 23 time shift from 1pm to noon explicit with a clear acceptance."
}
